g.text: PostgreSQL: Patroni HA behind one address
Every database consumer connects to one VIP. HAProxy only sends traffic to the current leader.
HAProxy + etcd on three LXCs: Hlin · Eir · Snotra (one per host)
PostgreSQL 17 on three LXCs: Fulla · Vör · Idunn (one per host)
traffic goes to the leader only
Patroni takes the leader lock in etcd
Leader = whoever holds the etcd lock. HAProxy asks each node's Patroni API: only the leader answers yes.
The others stream WAL from it and are marked down for clients.
Sources: docs/services/postgres.md, docs/known-issues/postgres.md. Local LVM-thin disks, never NFS: WAL fsync over 1 GbE would make every commit a network trip.
